simple.meaning: גּוּב (gûwb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to dig.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 2 Kings, beginning at 2 Kings 25:12. The surrounding contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גּוּב (H1461) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גּוּב (gûwb) / H1461 is traced through 2 Kings 25:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.
